summary: Closed roadmap task W0.2 (NPDEV_ROADMAP_2026-09-12.md, Wave 0) as PARTIAL, by an explicit scope decision made with the owner before starting: renamed the 4 generator emitter classes (TrustedSourceEmitter/Manifest/ControllerTemplate/TemplateSupport -> UntrustedExtension*) and their 10 test files, the 3 gate scripts (run-trusted-source-security-check/beta0-proof/beta0-proof-tests.ps1 -> run-untrusted-extension-*), plus every literal path reference to them (script-invocation-declarations.json, final-regression-coverage-manifest.json's finalEntrypoints/sourcePatterns, 4 caller scripts, a stale JUnit-XML lookup and a Gradle --tests filter that would otherwise have silently matched zero tests in a security check). Fixed 6 now-broken/inaccurate live-doc citations found along the way (docs/ADAPTER_REGISTRATION_CHECKLIST.md's literal dead path, CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/FLOWS.md, BONDS-AI-HANDOFF.md, dsl-conformance-max/Input/README.md) and one DONE ledger item's now-unresolvable guard.ref (QUAL-35). Deliberately did NOT rename: the two report schemas' scriptPath const (documented inline why), the generated-app OUTPUT contract (GeneratedTrustedSourceRuntimeController class/package/URL routes/permission strings -- author-facing, would need R11's migration codemod), the kernel's TrustedSourceBytecodeInspector + runtime-host plugin-isolation code, and ~15 closed historical ledger items -- renaming those was the only way to clear the task's numeric done-when threshold (fewer than 20 repo-wide TrustedSource mentions; 88 at start, 57 now), and the owner chose the generator-only scope over that larger, security-code-touching, history-rewriting alternative.
nextStep: Wave 0's last task, W0.3 (retire technology-neutral-model/layered-complexity's free-riding constitution-law status), is unblocked and small -- run 'python helpers/brief.py --next' from D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\NPDev_General__OutsideRepo\NPDEV_ROADMAP_2026-09-12 to get it briefed. Once W0.3 closes, Wave 0 is done and Wave 1 (the Runtime Shell, ~60% of the roadmap, critical path W1.1 -> W1.2 -> W1.7) is next -- see the roadmap's own Sequencing section (§4).
verified: Full run-generator-gate.ps1 (Java compile+test for the whole generator module, deterministic-generation check, out-of-tree generation check, run-untrusted-extension-security-check.ps1 as its own gate step) passed end to end after the rename. That security-check's own report shows overallStatus=passed with all 6 checks true, and its evidence proves the renamed --tests "*UntrustedExtension*" filter found and ran real tests (testCaseCount=6, compatibilityTestCaseCount=4) -- not a filter that silently matched zero tests. run-script-inventory-check.ps1 passed (227/227) after the 3 script renames. check-done-item-guards.py passed (0 blocking findings, 432 items) after fixing QUAL-35's guard.ref. python helpers/check_task.py --task W0.2 reports FAIL on the numeric threshold as expected and documented in ledger/items/W0.2.yml's notes -- its notExists condition (flagship file gone) passes.
